## Outcome

What observable behavior or scientific capability changes?

## Scope and non-goals

Which files and behaviors changed, and what was deliberately left alone?

## Scientific and data impact

List assumptions, units, tolerances, randomness, inputs/results, licenses, and
reproducibility implications, or state why none apply.

## Evidence

List exact commands, working directory, exit codes, and artifact paths. Include
focused tests and the applicable gauntlet profile.

## Risk and rollback

What can still be wrong, and how can this change be reverted safely?
